rule: No new paper orders 09:30-09:59 ET. Entries 10:00 until 15:40, only if today's Mxwll AOI was published from the open. Close everything from 15:40 so the desk is flat by 16:00 (the cloud runs every 10 minutes).

pulse_contradiction.note: When Market Pulse contradicts the side: 'reduce' sizes by size_factor, 'skip' passes on the idea.

sizing_note: Shares mode: 80% of $1,000 = $800 notional. Options mode: always exactly 1 contract, never resized to a dollar target.
